Dear All,

I am interested in hiring the Ashdown Eight for a film shoot. We plan to collect the vehicle on April 19, 2027 at 14:00 and return it on Wednesday 21 April 2027 at 5:00 pm. Could you arrange to have the vehicle delivered to Hotel Miramar Norvalle and then collect it from there afterwards.

I have included a copy of my driving licence for your reference.

Cheers,
Zane Tarnbrook
